entities.name: Iwset
entities.description: City-state of the Dark Age on the western coast of Terisiare near the Lat-Nam Straits.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: Era during which Iwset was a city-state.

entities.name: Lord Peemel
entities.description: Ruler of Iwset at a certain point in the Dark Age.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Advisor to Peemel and later co-ruler of Iwset with Edara.

entities.name: Edara
entities.description: Ruled Iwset with Apepei after the Iwset-Jehesic War.

entities.name: Jehesic
entities.description: Neighbor city across the Lat-Nam Straits, rival of Iwset.

events.summary: Iwset was ruled by Lord Peemel, advised by Digody and Apepei.
events.quote: Iwset was ruled by Lord Peemel , with the advisors Digody and Apepei counseling him

events.summary: After the Iwset-Jehesic War, Iwset was ruled by Edara and Apepei without the city's sigil or true heir.
events.quote: After the Iwset-Jehesic War , Iwset was ruled by Edara and Apepei, although with neither the sigil of the city nor the true heir at their disposal.
